C1842.title: Anti-Collection Black-Market Gang of Over 40 Members Busted for Forging Seals to Help Debtors Evade Repayment
C1842.summary: In January 2024, MaShang Consumer Finance, together with members of the Anti-Financial Black-Market Industry Alliance (AIF Alliance), assisted police in cracking a large-scale "anti-collection" fraud gang. Based in Zhengzhou, the gang posed as offering "debt negotiation," "debt optimization," and "debt restructuring," helping debtors forge seals and fabricate materials to maliciously complain against financial institutions and evade debts for illegal profit. Police arrested 41 suspects, seizing 99 forged hospital seals and one forgery device; suspects were subject to criminal coercive measures for suspected fraud and seal forgery.
